sources.title: Stream salinity status and trends in south-west Western Australia
sources.date_basis: Title page, Report No. SLUI 38, January 2005.
sources.source_role: Direct official river maps and named confluence/course descriptions, independently created from the later BOM assessment.
own_factual_extraction: The Moore description distinguishes Marchagee, Coonderoo and Moore River North. The North and East branches unite before the Moore continues via Regans Ford to Guilderton. Gingin Brook joins at the estuary head.

The Murray description identifies the Hotham-Williams confluence south of Boddington as the formation of the Murray, followed by the Darling Range and coastal plain. The river reaches the ocean via Peel Inlet near Mandurah.

Figure 3.27 labels the Hotham, Williams and Murray courses separately; Figure 3.37 labels the Moore corridor to Guilderton. Their complete mapped courses provide regional comparison with the selected paths.
limits: The maps are regional and lack a coordinate-resolved name-boundary crosswalk to the selected source reaches. Shared underlying geographic data between official publications are possible; distinct publications do not imply independent surveys.

sources.title: Moore River - Healthy Rivers
sources.agency_or_publisher: Western Australia Department of Water and Environmental Regulation
sources.date_basis: No original publication or last-update date established from the acquired page.
sources.source_role: Official English usage and explicit separate named monitoring sites.
own_factual_extraction: The monitoring list separately uses Moore River and Moore River North Branch, alongside Gingin Brook, Lennard Brook and other tributaries. Moore sites include Mogumber West Nature Reserve, Regans Ford, Waterville Road and Indian Ocean Drive.
limits: The page is used for inspected text only. Its interactive map was not loaded or treated as inspected cartographic evidence. Site names are not a complete reach-name inventory.

sources.title: Murray River - Healthy Rivers
sources.agency_or_publisher: Western Australia Department of Water and Environmental Regulation
sources.date_basis: No original publication or last-update date established from the acquired page.
sources.source_role: Official English usage, western-Australian location, tributary distinction and estuary relation.
own_factual_extraction: The profile places the Hotham headwaters near Narrogin and Williams headwaters between Williams and Narrogin. It describes the Murray through the Darling Range to Pinjarra, joined downstream by Dandalup, and ending in the Peel-Harvey Estuary near Mandurah.
limits: The basin contains several named rivers. The profile does not name every selected part or justify calling the estuary and ocean connector Murray River.

sources.source_role: Explicit separation of estuarine basins, river reaches and ocean channels.
own_factual_extraction: The estuary comprises Peel Inlet and Harvey Estuary and includes estuarine reaches of the Murray, Serpentine and Harvey rivers. Mandurah Channel and Dawesville Cut link this estuarine complex to the Indian Ocean.
limits: The landing page was acquired; the linked 12.46 MB report was not downloaded or inspected. It establishes naming distinctions, not an exact baseline-fragment boundary.
